reviewPrompt: Independently review the committed corrected tiny-overfit pilot at fbb54e05ac69daca3c7d6e2f446126da52050c88. Inspect ingest_factory.py, review.py, source schema, tiny-overfit-pilot.json, Tier-A mappings, additional drafts and the immutable factory dataset. Revalidate the nine false-NONE corrections, same-value alternatives, all direct labels and selected Tier-A identities against complete source records and the production target catalogue. Approve only the exact 18-record train pilot with 79 positive and 29 absent direct decisions plus 14 positive identities. Record honest independent GPT-6 model provenance, never human review. No training, promotion, publishing or runtime changes.

reviewDisclosure.meaningOfBlind: Independent semantic review without model prediction results; draft labels and prior requested corrections were visible. This is not a blinded-label study.
reviewDisclosure.scope: Exactly 18 listed training records, six direct targets, four Entra clientUserName labels and ten Defender/UDM sourceUsername labels. Other targets unlabelled. Additional drafts and other Tier-A families are not approved.
limitations: Tiny overfit and save/reload experiment only; no release training approval or production accuracy evidence.
Synthetic variants within a family share scenarios and do not constitute independent validation.
Additional drafts integrity checked only; remain review-required.
